name: LGG Media

success.claim: Self-reported: #182 Globe and Mail Canada's Top Growing Companies 2026, 147% 3-yr revenue growth
2026 Google Ads Impact Award (press release): health-insurance brokerage scaled $5K -> $130K daily spend

borrow: Numbered process with tracking BEFORE ads: discovery -> tracking infra -> campaigns -> scale on verified revenue
Reporting defined by data source: CRM/POS/payment data matched to ad click, not platform estimates; 'no status calls about CTR'
Founder access backed by published client cap (max 15 accounts)
No-lock-in in FAQ + qualifier in hero (spend threshold)
Case cards: one bold figure + spend trajectory + timeframe; free ROAS calculator
weakness: Bare multipliers without baseline; only founder shown

name: Grow and Convert

success.claim: Two co-founders launched May 2017; 4 months later $34,000/month revenue
100+ clients in 10 years; logos Yelp, LastPass, Wrike, Patreon

borrow: Price and terms on service page: '$10k/month', 'no 6 or 12 month contract'
Monthly report = leads and sales produced, first/last-touch; accountable to conversions not traffic
'All clients work directly with our strategists, no intermediary account managers'
Case studies as long-form research posts with conversion data (proof + SEO asset)
Named method ('Pain Point SEO') everywhere — method is the brand
weakness: Differentiators buried on inner pages; stale $199 services page

name: KlientBoost

success.claim: $500K MRR after three years (2018), $1.4M profit 2017, ~150 clients, 45 people

borrow: Dated accountability stat: 'We Hit 83% of Client Goals In Q2 2026' with quarter shown
Primary CTA = free research deliverable ('Free Marketing Plan': ICP, top-3 competitors, keywords, mockups)
Results gallery filterable by 'Buyer type' — maps to quote/cart/calendar
Testimonials grouped by objection (Results, Cost, Speed...)
Mechanism framing: 'KPI vs time tracking'
weakness: 'Pricing' page with no prices; loud tone

name: Refine Labs
borrow: Research sold as fixed product: 'Revenue Performance Assessment — from $35,000 — 6 weeks' with deliverable list, no long-term commitment
Aggregate stats with denominator: '5 of 8 clients grew high-intent demand'
Like-for-like period cases ('H1 2023 vs H1 2024')
3-word method + 3 CTAs by intent level
weakness: Founder face gone from site after he stepped back

name: Disruptive Advertising

success.claim: From two employees in founder's basement to 120+ and $18M run rate
Self-reported: 4.8 from 350+ Clutch reviews, 90+ clients retained 4+ years

borrow: Dedicated risk-reversal block ('Results in 90 days or you don't pay') — model for per-qualified-lead fee block
Free audit valuable even if they never hire you
Retention stat next to 'no long-term contracts'
Empathy hero: blame the system, not the reader
weakness: Scarcity/hype devices, unsourced stats — don't copy

name: Wolfgang Digital

success.claim: Kitchen-table start 2007; 100+ international awards; Google #1 agency in EMEA x3 (self-reported)
Six awards at European Search Awards 2025 incl. Best Large SEO Agency
Largest independent Irish digital agency, ~70 staff pre-Covid, plan to 120

borrow: Annual open-access benchmark study (E-commerce KPI Report, 130M sessions) as PR + proof engine
Each case card carries exactly 3 comparable metrics
One-sentence humble origin story
Owner mindset as client benefit
weakness: Rotating-label hero says nothing about outcome; award wall

name: Exposure Ninja

success.claim: Five awards at Global Search Awards 2025 (e.g. The Ordinary 395% ROI)
Founded 2012 from a neighbour's plastering site; 100+ people; 50,000+ copies of its book

borrow: Free review page 'By a Person, Not a Tool — no AI, no template PDF', live walkthrough, eligibility stated
Results labelled client-type + metric ('640% more conversions for finance firm') — anonymous but concrete
Industry research reports as lead magnets
Nav: Industries / Results / Resources for self-selection
weakness: Award + lead-magnet overload competes with one CTA

name: Rise at Seven

success.claim: Founded 2019 by two; GBP 1.5m turnover year one, 2 -> 24 people in 12 months

borrow: Triage by problem type ('Demand or Discovery') not service — same idea as quote/cart/calendar
Case teasers = one metric + brand
One-line philosophy repeated on every page
Forwardable results PDF for internal champions
